name: Payment Mandate Spend Authorization Requested
description: Bank asks a Payment Mandate document to authorize a single spend before reserve/capture execution.

authorizationId.description: Correlation and idempotency key for a single authorization lifecycle.

amountMinor.description: Requested amount in minor currency units.

currency.description: Currency used to validate amountMinor against mandate limits.

counterpartyId.description: Counterparty identifier interpreted according to counterpartyType.

requestingDocumentId.description: Document id that requested the charge.

requestingSessionId.description: Session id that requested the charge.

requestedAt.description: Timestamp when the authorization request was created.
